quest.title: Dandelion, Rose, and Windwheel Aster
quest.description: "What on earth happened that Acting Grand Master Jean is going to the tavern?" "Calm down, it's the Acting Grand Master we're talking about. Besides, she wouldn't be there if something bad were really going on."

talks.objective: Talk to Luka and enter the tavern

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Hi there, cutie. It's good to see you.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: It is certainly unusual for us to meet in a place like this, but as Lisa said, I'm glad to see you.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Hey, what do you mean by "a place like this"? The tavern is a wonderful place to relax and unwind a little.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: *sigh* Do you have any idea how hard it was for me to drag the Acting Grand Master away from her desk?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: We've only been here for a few minutes and worry is already written all over her face.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: *sigh* Lisa...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, the Knights of Favonius do have a lot to handle...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, this is the Acting Grand Master we're talking about. It's only natural that she has a lot on her plate!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But you know what they say... "Now that we're already here..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Why don't you let {F#her}{M#him} mix a couple of drinks for you two. It'll make you feel a lot better!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Think of it as a way to unwind.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Honestly, Jean is the only person I know who needs to be taught how to relax.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Hey cutie, whip me up a Love Poem. Medium, extra sweet.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: And how about you, Jean? What are you in the mood for?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I'll just have... coffee. Medium, please.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Master Jean, you drink coffee all the time. Wouldn't you like to try something else?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Thanks, but no. I want something to help keep me awake.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Got it. Coming right up!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Thanks.

talks.objective: Head to the counter and get ready to open for business

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Mmm... The sweetness is just right. Very good.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: The coffee is strong and rich with just a nice hint of bitterness to it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm glad you both like the drinks.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Actually, I do understand what you meant, Lisa.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I've been reflecting on my weaknesses lately. There's still room for me to improve in many areas, such as my productivity and management...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I'm concerned my stress may even be starting to somehow affect you as well...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think you still don't quite understand.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: What?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Hehe. See? Cutie knows.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: You were working yourself way too hard, so I thought I'd take you out for some drinks. All I wanted was for you to have some fun.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: But even in the tavern, you're still thinking about work. That's what's most concerning.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: If you're constantly under stress like this, it's only a matter of time before you burn out.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Exactly.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: #Oh... You also agree with Lisa, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Hmm, so... is learning to relax actually my biggest challenge?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: To quote a saying from Liyue: "Everything has a balance."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yep! Work hard, play hard, and rest even harder. The two of you may need even more rest than you'd expect!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's an... interesting way to put it.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Alright, I... I understand.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Thank you, all of you. Now I know that this place serves refreshments for both the body and the mind. Is that why you and Kaeya like the tavern so much?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Yes, and no. It really depends on who's making the drinks.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, we couldn't have changed Jean's mind without you today. You sure have a way with words, Cutie.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Hehe, then we'll see you later.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: I'll consider coming here to relax if I have another opportunity.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds great. Take care, you two!

talks.objective: Give the drinks to Lisa and Jean
